name: Squat
instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width apart, sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then drive up through your heels.

name: Push-up
instructions: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up without letting your hips sag.

name: Lunge
instructions: Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees, keep your torso upright, then push back to standing.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders. Hold a straight line from head to heels with your core braced.

name: Jumping jack
instructions: Jump your feet wide while raising both arms overhead, then jump back to the start.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, pull until your chin passes the bar, then lower with control.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Hang with an underhand grip, pull your chin over the bar, and lower slowly.

name: Bench dip
instructions: Hands on a bench behind you, lower your body by bending the elbows, then press back up.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, and lower.

name: Sit-up
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and curl your torso up to your thighs, then lower with control.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, lift your shoulders off the floor by contracting your abs, and lower slowly.

name: Mountain climber
instructions: From a high plank, drive your knees toward your chest alternately at a steady pace.

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat down, kick your feet back to a plank, do a push-up, jump your feet in, and jump up.

name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down and lift your arms and legs off the floor together, hold briefly, then lower.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Slide down a wall until your knees are at 90 degrees and hold the position.

name: Calf raise
instructions: Stand tall and rise onto the balls of your feet, pause at the top, and lower slowly.

name: Step-up
instructions: Step onto a sturdy box with one foot, drive up until standing, and step back down.

name: Pike push-up
instructions: From a downward-dog position, bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor, then press up.

name: Russian twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent and torso leaned back, rotate your shoulders side to side.

name: Leg raise
instructions: Lie on your back and lift straight legs to vertical, then lower without touching the floor.

name: Bird dog
instructions: On hands and knees, extend the opposite arm and leg, hold, and switch sides.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent, lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping your back flat.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench, press two dumbbells from chest level to arms extended, and lower under control.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Press dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead without arching your lower back.

name: Dumbbell row
instructions: Hand and knee on a bench, pull the dumbbell to your hip and lower it slowly.

name: Bicep curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells up with your elbows fixed at your sides, then lower slowly.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Curl with palms facing each other, keeping your elbows still.

name: Overhead tricep extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, bend the elbows to lower it behind your head, and extend.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and squat deep, keeping your chest up.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a slight knee bend, lower the dumbbells along your legs, and stand tall.

name: Lateral raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells out to your sides to shoulder height with a soft elbow bend.

name: Dumbbell lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and perform lunges, alternating legs.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Bar across your upper back, squat to at least parallel, and stand up keeping your torso braced.

name: Bench press
instructions: Lower the bar to your mid-chest with control and press it back up. Use a spotter for heavy sets.

name: Deadlift
instructions: With a flat back, drive through your legs to lift the bar to standing, then lower it along your legs.

name: Overhead press
instructions: Press the bar from your collarbone to overhead, moving your head through at the top.

name: Barbell row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, pull the bar to your lower ribs, and lower it slowly.

name: Hip thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench with the bar over your hips, drive your hips up until your body is level.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Hinge and swing the kettlebell to chest height by snapping your hips forward.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to your upper chest while keeping your torso steady, then let it rise with control.

name: Leg press
instructions: Press the platform away until your legs are almost straight, then lower without lifting your hips.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Pull the handle to your abdomen, squeeze your shoulder blades together, and return slowly.

name: Leg curl
instructions: Curl the pad toward your glutes and lower it with control.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Extend your legs until straight, pause, and lower slowly.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Hold a band at chest height and pull it apart by squeezing your shoulder blades.

name: Running
instructions: Run at a steady, conversational pace with a relaxed upper body.

name: Cycling
instructions: Pedal at a steady cadence with the seat set so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Turn the rope with your wrists and jump just high enough to clear it.

name: Cat-cow
instructions: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding your spine with your breathing.

name: Hip flexor stretch
instructions: In a half-kneeling position, tuck your pelvis and shift forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.

name: Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or two sturdy chairs with straight arms, lower until your upper arms are level with the floor, then press back up.
